About this product

The VSOL V2804AC-Z is a dual-mode Optical Network Unit (ONU) designed for high-performance fibre optic networks. It supports both EPON and GPON technologies, offering flexibility for various Fibre-to-the-Home (FTTH) and Fibre-to-the-Building (FTTB) installations. This device provides high-speed connectivity through its integrated dual-band WiFi 5 (802.11ac) access point and four Gigabit Ethernet (GE) LAN ports. The V2804AC-Z is a reliable terminal for delivering data, voice, and video services over a fibre connection, making it a suitable choice for internet service providers and end-users.
